old_problem: Two copied Correctable step labels contradicted the title, Criteria and errortype=1, while link0, expected sync-flood/reset/crash behavior, timeout and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The item title, Criteria and both literal errortype=1 commands independently establish UCE scope, so the two Correctable labels are rejected as copied wording in the review layer. ED-03 binds topology and package semantics; ED-16 requires a predicted containment outcome, dedicated SUT and recovery before a single destructive checkpoint. IOD and CCD remain separately authorized, never an automatic sequence.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 39, DeepSeek fields, historical record 2442 and next pending row 40.
Used three concordant source elements—title, Criteria and errortype=1—to resolve the two conflicting step labels as non-authoritative text.
Preserved independent IOD and CCD UCE coverage and rejected link0 without topology proof.
Required OS-specific UCE and expected reset/sync-flood/crash disposition, not tool PASS alone.
No BIOS/HDT action, injection, reset or recovery was executed.

test_case.test_name: GMI3 uncorrectable error at IOD and CCD origins
test_case.purpose: Validate project-defined containment and full recovery for one attributable GMI3 UCE at each approved IOD and CCD origin.
required_package: Enumerated GMI link-to-IOD/CCD topology and coverage
AMD tool/spec hash/license proving errortype=1 UCE semantics
Per-origin severity, sync-flood/reset/crash expectation and deadlines
Linux MCA/APEI or Windows WHEA/console plus BMC/UEFI oracle
Isolated-SUT abort, OOB recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: After topology and containment approval, a qualified FAE performs only one mapped errortype=1/linktraffic=1 checkpoint at the authorized IOD or CCD origin. Capture continuous OOB/tool/OS/management evidence, execute the approved recovery, verify fabric/system integrity and restoration, then require separate authorization before the other origin.
test_case.expected_result: The chosen origin produces the exact approved UCE and containment/reset behavior within its deadline, recovers without residual fabric/system damage, and later independent authorization yields equivalent attributable coverage for the other origin.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed UCE semantics, correct origin/link, predicted containment, complete OS/OOB evidence and successful bounded recovery/restoration for each independent checkpoint. Tool PASS alone, Correctable evidence, uncontrolled crash or automatic second injection cannot pass.
safety_gate: Non-production SUT, backup, independent console and authorized recovery path.
One UCE at one mapped origin per explicit approval.
Stop on wrong target/severity, storm, unexpected reset, lost link/console or failed recovery.
Never auto-retry or proceed to the second origin before review.
expected_evidence: Post-recovery fabric health, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: Use only the pre-approved OOB reset/power/reimage sequence matching the predicted UCE disposition, preserve evidence first, close the injector, restore BIOS/HDT values and prove GMI/system health before any new authorization.
